ex.note: Heavy day. Bench at 15-30 degrees. Add weight once you hit 8 reps on every set.
Squeeze glutes and brace your core. Only direct vertical press of the week.
Mid-height pulleys. Slow 2-3 sec lowering, feel the stretch, slight elbow bend.
Lead with the elbow. Stop just above shoulder height.
Keep elbows pinned to your sides.
Cable or dumbbell. Full stretch at the bottom.
Hinge to about 45 degrees. Pull to lower ribs, no body English.
Can swap for pull-ups. Lead with the elbows, full stretch at the top.
Pause 1 sec at the squeeze.
Pull to forehead height, rotate hands outward.
Do not swing. Control the lowering.
Neutral grip.
Hit depth at or below parallel. Heavy day.
Soft knees, push hips back, feel the hamstring stretch.
Full range, do not lock out hard.
Slow lowering.
Squeeze at the top.
Pause 1-2 sec at the bottom stretch.
Round the spine, do not just hinge at the hips.
Lighter, higher-rep day. Same 15-30 degree bench angle.
Lean forward to bias the chest. Add weight once you reach 12 reps.
Or low-to-high cable fly. Control the stretch.
Light weight, strict form. Last set can be a partial-rep burnout.
Lower to forehead or just behind the head.
Use a lat pulldown if you cannot do 6 clean reps.
Chest on the pad, drive elbows back.
Keep arms nearly straight, feel the lats.
Rear delts. Light weight, no momentum.
Full stretch at the bottom.
Can swap for front squat.
Pause 1 sec at the top.
Reps are per leg.
Slow lowering.
Pause at the bottom stretch.
Curl the pelvis up, do not swing.
